meta.title: Stackrift — the falling-blocks game, reinvented
meta.description: The falling-blocks game reinvented: brand-new modes, a daily challenge, shattering crystal. Free, no sign-up, on mobile and desktop.

app.name: Stackrift
app.tagline: The rules you know. Games you have never played.
app.privacy: No account, no tracking: your records stay on your device.

home.comingSoon: Coming soon: Fusion, Tilt, Silhouette, Rhythm, Duel, Sand, Mosaic and Tower.

daily.title: Daily Challenge
daily.rules: Two minutes, the same pieces for everyone.

classic.name: Classic
classic.pitch: The reference: a little faster every 10 lines.

tide.name: Tide
tide.pitch: Rows rise from the bottom, faster and faster. Hold on.

flip.name: Flip
flip.pitch: Turn the well upside down: the stack falls back and holes vanish.

chroma.name: Chroma
chroma.pitch: A line of a single colour is worth four times as much.

mirror.name: Mirror
mirror.pitch: Every 10 lines, the well is mirrored. Adapt.

notice.mirrorSoon: The well is about to be mirrored

controls.label: Touch controls
controls.keyboard: Keyboard: arrows to move and drop, Space for a hard drop, ↑ or X to rotate, Ctrl to rotate the other way, C to hold, F for the ability, Esc to pause.
controls.touch: Touch: swipe to move, tap to rotate, swipe down fast for a hard drop.
